name: Level_2 - Task_9
description: Generate a finite-temperature molecular dynamics trajectory of bulk Copper and train a Ridge regression model (α = 1e-4) on Smooth Overlap of Atomic Positions (SOAP) descriptors to predict instantaneous potential energies. Start with a conventional face-centered cubic (FCC) unit cell of Copper (a = 3.615 Å) expanded into a 2 × 2 × 2 supercell. Use the MACE-MP-0 foundation model as the calculator. Conduct molecular dynamics simulations in the canonical (NVT) ensemble using a Langevin thermostat at 800 K with a 1.0 fs timestep and a friction coefficient of 0.01 fs⁻¹ for 1,000 steps. Sample the atomic configuration and instantaneous total potential energy every 10 steps to yield a chronological dataset of 100 configurations. Compute SOAP descriptors for all configurations using the dscribe library with species=['Cu'], r_cut=5.0 Å, n_max=6, l_max=6, periodic=True, and average='inner'. Chronologically partition the data, using the first 80 configurations for training and the remaining 20 for testing. Save the trained model to a pickle file and return the absolute path to this file.
submission_format: string representing the absolute path to the output file (eg. '/path/to/trained_model.pkl')
